children.prompt: Identify why the two triangles are similar

answer.short: At least two pairs of equal corresponding angles (AAA).
answer.worked: $\angle A=\angle D$ and $\angle B=\angle E$ (marked). Therefore $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DEF$, since at least two pairs of corresponding angles are equal.

$EF$ corresponds to $BC$, and $DE$ corresponds to $AB$.
